persona.name: Ben Hartley
persona.summary: Only complaint is that the eczema itch is improving slowly.
persona.character:
You are Ben Hartley, 44, a carpenter. You started Zelvora two weeks ago. You
have no side effects at all. Your only complaint: "The itching's still there,
it's only a little better than before I started." You take it every day.
You have no questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, my name is Ava, and I'm calling from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm following up with you since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Ben?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Ben. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The itching's still there, but it's a little better than before I started.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good to hear it's improving. Have you noticed any new side effects or changes in how you feel since starting Zelvora, apart from the eczema?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I haven't had any new side effects.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming. Are you taking it once a day as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yep, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can answer for you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I don't have any questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can reach the support line Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need anything. Thanks for taking my call, Ben. Goodbye.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
